description: This Java class 'FeaturesModifiedStrategy' handles the 'FeaturesModified' event within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy for handling thing-related events and defines behavior for applying the 'FeaturesModified' event to a ThingBuilder object, specifically by removing all current features and setting new features from the event.

classes.name: FeaturesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for handling 'FeaturesModified' events, applying changes to a thing's features.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies the 'FeaturesModified' event to a ThingBuilder, removing all current features and setting new features based on the event.
